label: PvDeviceState
info:
Reads PV Device State from registers:
- 96-97: Total PV Energy (0.1kWh, 32-bit)
- 108: Day PV Power (0.1kWh)
- 109-116: MPPT 1-4 Voltage/Current
- 186-189: MPPT 1-4 Power

Triggers:
1. RPC: getPvDeviceState

name: Prepare read (Total Energy 96-97)
Prepare read (Daily/MPPT V/I 108-116)
Prepare read (MPPT Power 186-189)
Build PvDeviceState JSON
Prepare RPC Response
